_about: Every file that puts a roll on record by hand, outside the one door for it (src/lib/dm/roll-record.ts recordRoll): how many times it stores one (insertRoll), sends one (a publish of "roll_result") and adds one to a turn's cards (a push or other write onto rollIds, or joinStoredTurn), and the family of sites it moves onto the door with. None is left: the last family moved in issue #915's last part, so a file that shows up here is new, and goes through recordRoll instead. `total` is the sum of the counts. Held by scripts/test-roll-record-sites.mjs; `node scripts/test-roll-record-sites.mjs --counts` prints what the source holds now.
_asked: The files that may tell the door a roll is one an AI GM asked for with request_roll (recordRoll's `asked`, and createPendingRoll's for the card dealt for one; issue #1073): where that call is thrown on the server's dice or deals its card, and where the card lands. The mark is what lets a roll's total pay for a number the GM sends (src/lib/dm/ai-gate.ts), so a third file here needs a reason in its diff. No file but the door and the turn store writes a turn's asked or paid list by hand.
_rows: The rows of scripts/test-enforce-sweep-dice-sites.mjs whose call stores a roll that fails a check of its record, and which checks: home (the roll is on no turn and no line, so the chronicle never shows its card), sent (dice the seat entered are on record and sent as the server's, so the stage throws them again), roller (an attack or damage roll names nobody, so it reads as the roll of the character it lands on; or a roll nobody made names a source that does not say what it is, says that source a second time, or does not name the character it lands on), asked (the roll is marked as one an AI GM asked for and no GM's request_roll made it, or a GM's request_roll did not mark the one roll it asked for). None is left. A row that fails a check fails that suite unless it is listed here; `ODM_SWEEP_ROWS=print node scripts/test-enforce-sweep-dice-sites.mjs` prints the list as it stands.
